function.name: calculate_future_value
function.description: Calculate the future value of an investment given the initial amount, interest rate, and investment duration.

interest_rate.description: The annual interest rate in decimal form. This is a float type value.

compounded.description: The number of times the interest is compounded per year. Default is 1 (annual compounding).
